module: Manager of the roadside furniture (guardrails, fences, lampposts) of a Hero Road Editor group. It reads the group's mesh edges (meshEdgeL/R, meshEdgeDirL/R, meshEdgeUp) and places pieces via editor/toolUtilities/roadsideProps (transient pools identified by id..'bL', 'fL', 'lL'...). It handles the rails of the whole road (Furniture tab) and the placed barrier segments (Features tab, group.barriers).
notes: Vertical offset (burial) per barrier type: guardrail -0.35 m, jersey 0.0, plastic -0.15 m; added to the segment's zOffsetM.
Group defaults: barrierOffsetM 0.5, fenceOffsetM 0.7, lampOffsetM 1.0 (meters, lateral offset outward from the edge).
The types are 'none' if absent; 'none' places nothing. The lampposts are anchored at both ends (lockEnds) with spacing group.lampSpacingM.
A baked road no longer has pieces in the pools: counts then returns 0.

updateGroup.desc: (Re)builds the group's barriers, fences and lampposts from the current mesh edges and the selections. Called after the mesh is rebuilt; does nothing if the group has no scenetree folder (sceneTreeFolderId).

group.desc: Hero Road group (id, sceneTreeFolderId, meshEdgeL/R, barrierLeftType, fenceLeftType, lampLeftType, barriers...).

counts.desc: Number of pieces currently placed for the group, per category, both sides combined. Reads the transient pools (so the editable preview).

removeGroup.desc: Removes all the furniture placed for the group (teardown or fewer than 2 nodes).

burnGroup.desc: "Burn": makes the current pieces persistent (canSave=true) via props.commitPool and detaches them from the transient pools. Returns the manifest of names, which exportMgr stores during the bake.

returns.desc: Array of identifiers/names of created scene objects (empty if the group is invalid).
